default_context.values: Verified definition defaults, not personal configured values. Entries marked inherit deliberately have no fixed value; their effective value comes from the theme or another setting. Profiles, policies, extensions, language overrides, and other platforms may change effective defaults.

setting_contract.identity: A setting is identified by settings_name together with settings_path, which defaults to an empty array. Repeated names with different paths are intentional.
setting_contract.settings_path: An array of literal object-property keys inside the named setting. Dots inside a key are not path separators.
setting_contract.settings_value_mode: Absent or value means an explicit typed value. inherit means no override and requires settings_value to be null. A null value without inherit remains a genuine explicit null.
setting_contract.inherit_behavior: When applying inherit, remove only the targeted override at the selected configuration scope. For an empty path, remove the setting at that scope. Never write the inheritance sentinel as a null override.
setting_contract.merge_behavior: When applying a nested value, preserve all unrelated properties of the containing setting. Reject incompatible object shapes rather than replacing them silently. For token groups, promote an existing color string to an object with foreground before adding style properties.
setting_contract.theme_scope: Customization paths here target global overrides. Theme-specific overrides may take precedence and are preserved. Editing theme-specific paths is not yet supported.
setting_contract.settings_control: A proposed GUI control, not an implemented widget. color accepts hexadecimal RGB or RGBA colors; font selects a font family; select uses settings_options; text accepts free text.
setting_contract.scope: The extension applies catalog edits to the active user profile and previews supported visual choices. Presets are registered for native Settings Sync. Exporting a named theme extension and theme-specific editing are not implemented.

Visual interface.description: The appearance and layout of the VS Code window.

Interface colors.description: Override individual background and foreground colors, or inherit them from the active theme.

Editor surface.description: Colors of the editing surface, selection, current line, and cursor.

settings.settings_description: Choose the editor background color, or inherit it from the theme.
Choose the default editor text color. Syntax highlighting can assign different colors to code.
Choose the background of selected text. Transparency can keep highlighting visible beneath the selection.
Choose the background highlight for the current line.
Choose the color of the editor cursor.

settings.settings_description: Choose the background of the sidebar.
Choose the default sidebar text color. Specialized elements may have their own colors.
Choose the background of sidebar section headings.
Choose the text color of sidebar section headings.

settings.settings_description: Choose the background of the active editor tab.
Choose the text color of the active editor tab.
Choose the background of inactive editor tabs.
Choose the text color of inactive editor tabs.

Status bar.description: Default status-bar colors. Debugging and windows without an open folder can use separate colors.

settings.settings_description: Choose the default status-bar background.
Choose the default text color in the status bar.

Code highlighting.description: Customize syntax colors and styles. Semantic highlighting can override syntax colors when a language provider supplies more specific information.

settings.settings_description: Choose the text color of comments.
Choose font styles for comments, or inherit their styling.
Choose the text color of strings.
Choose font styles for strings, or inherit their styling.
Choose the text color of language keywords.
Choose font styles for keywords, or inherit their styling.
Choose the text color of numeric literals.
Choose font styles for numeric literals, or inherit their styling.
Choose the text color of type names.
Choose font styles for type names, or inherit their styling.
Choose the text color of function names.
Choose font styles for function names, or inherit their styling.
Choose the text color of variable names.
Choose font styles for variable names, or inherit their styling.

Semantic highlighting.description: More specific highlighting based on language understanding. These rules depend on the token types supplied by the active language provider.

settings.settings_description: Enable or disable semantic highlighting, or inherit the existing preference.
Choose the color of tokens identified as variables by the language provider.
Choose the color of tokens identified as functions by the language provider.

Window layout.description: Position and visibility of the main interface regions.

settings.settings_description: Place the primary sidebar on the left or right of the editor.
Show the bar containing status information at the bottom of the window.

AI and chats.description: AI-assisted workflows and conversations. This starting selection covers code blocks in chat, not provider-specific model configuration.

Conversation appearance.description: How code is displayed inside conversations.

Code blocks.description: Font and wrapping preferences for code shown in chat.

settings.settings_description: Set the text size of code blocks shown in chat.
Choose the font for chat code blocks, or keep the default font selection.
Choose the font weight for chat code blocks, or keep the default weight.
Choose whether long lines in chat code blocks wrap onto another line.

Source control.description: Version-control workflows, starting with the built-in Git integration.

Git integration.description: Enable Git support and organize repository actions.

settings.settings_description: Enable the built-in Git features for repositories.

Fetching and synchronization.description: Retrieve remote changes and confirm synchronization actions.

settings.settings_description: Choose whether to fetch remote changes automatically. This also supports fetching from all remotes, so its control needs more than a checkbox.
Request confirmation before synchronizing a repository with its remote.

Committing.description: Control how changes are prepared for a commit.

settings.settings_description: Allow committing all changes when no changes have been staged.

Terminals.description: The appearance and behavior of integrated terminals.

settings.settings_description: Choose the terminal font, or inherit the editor font.
Set the text size in integrated terminals.
Choose the weight of normal terminal text.
Choose a block, line, or underline cursor.

Colors.description: Terminal colors independent of editor text. Individual ANSI palette colors can be added later.

settings.settings_description: Choose the terminal background, or retain the theme's inherited background.
Choose the default terminal text color. Programs can still use ANSI colors.
Choose the terminal cursor color.

Output history.description: How much terminal output remains available.

settings.settings_description: Set how many lines of previous terminal output can be scrolled back through.

Editor.description: Writing and reading text and code, independent of a particular language.

settings.settings_description: Choose the editor font and its fallback fonts. Font availability depends on the computer.
Set the size of text in the editor.
Choose the weight of editor text.
Control whether supported character combinations are drawn as combined glyphs. Advanced values can select individual font features.

Indentation.description: Preferred spacing for indentation. Automatic indentation detection can override these preferences for an opened file.

settings.settings_description: Set how many spaces a tab represents.
Insert spaces rather than a tab character when indenting.

Reading and navigation.description: Keep code readable and make large files easier to navigate.

settings.settings_description: Choose whether long lines remain unwrapped or wrap at the viewport, a chosen column, or a combination of both.
Show a miniature overview of the current file beside the editor.

Extensions.description: General extension management. Settings for specific workflows belong in their workflow categories.

Updates.description: Checking for and installing extension updates.

settings.settings_description: Choose whether extensions update automatically.
Check automatically whether newer extension versions are available.

PlatformIO.description: Embedded-development preferences supplied by the PlatformIO IDE extension. These settings require that extension.

Toolchain.description: Choose which Python interpreter and PlatformIO Core installation the extension uses.

settings.settings_description: Use the portable Python interpreter supplied for PlatformIO when available.
Use the PlatformIO Core installation managed by the extension.

Projects.description: Project activation, configuration, and code indexing.

settings.settings_human_read: Activate the project of the current editor
settings.settings_description: Automatically switch the active project to match the file being edited.
Open the project's configuration file when no other editors are open.

settings.settings_description: Show shortcuts for build, upload, and other project actions in the editor title area.

Serial monitor.description: Coordinate serial monitoring with uploading and testing.

settings.settings_human_read: Close the monitor before device operations
settings.settings_description: Close the serial monitor automatically before uploading or testing.
Set the delay in milliseconds before the serial monitor reopens.

Files and folders.description: Browsing, saving, and managing files and folders.

Saving.description: Automatic saving and cleanup when saving files.

settings.settings_description: Choose whether files save automatically after a delay or when focus changes.
Set the delay in milliseconds when delayed automatic saving is selected.
Remove unnecessary whitespace at the ends of lines when saving.
Request confirmation before deleting files through the explorer.

Search.description: Finding text across files and choosing which files are searched.

settings.settings_description: Use case-sensitive matching when a search contains uppercase letters, unless case matching is explicitly selected.

Files included.description: How ignore rules and linked files affect searches.

settings.settings_description: Exclude files covered by project ignore rules when searching.
Include files reached through symbolic links in searches.

Languages.description: Language-specific behavior, separate from general editor preferences.
